I'm **Ba-Hien Tran**, a senior machine learning research scientist at Huawei Paris. My research is in Bayesian deep learning, efficient AI architectures, and probabilistic modeling. I'm a first author at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, and JMLR, principal inventor on 30+ patents, and the recipient of the Best PhD Thesis Award from Sorbonne University (2023).

**nano-agents** is my study notebook on agentic AI, written publicly. The goal is to internalize the field through the lens I already know best — probabilistic modeling and Bayesian inference — and to share the derivations and code that emerge along the way.

If something here is wrong, unclear, or could be sharper, please [open an issue](https://github.com/tranbahien/nano-agents/issues).
